statement: Flip a deeply nested data tree by swapping the last unique path index with the item index, extending the standard flip matrix to trees with more than one level.
superiority: Dino 8 should provide a general N-level tree transpose with an axis choice, as a native operation.

acceptance.tolerance: Transposed tree has expected path set; flipping twice reproduces the original exactly

statement: Renumber the branch paths of a tree into a clean consecutive sequence while keeping the branch contents and order.
superiority: Dino 8 should renumber at any path level with a preview of the old-to-new map.

acceptance.tolerance: Result paths {0},{1},{2},{3}; contents of each branch byte-identical

statement: Expand a reference tree so it is duplicated as a new branch for each input branch by prepending an index to its paths, and unflatten each branch of a tree this way.

source.ref: Prepend index / unflatten each branch technique

superiority: Dino 8 should include an Unflatten-by-branch tree operator so the pattern needs no helper definitions.

acceptance.corpus: Input tree with 6 branches and reference tree with 4 branches
acceptance.tolerance: Output has 24 branches with expected paths; matches a hand-computed reference exactly

notes: Forum post describes the technique and an attached definition; individual component names were not given.

statement: Split a tree by its first path index into separate trees while keeping the remaining structure (explode at index).
superiority: Dino 8 should offer a single explode-by-path-level operation that keeps structure.

acceptance.tolerance: Two output trees; item totals and order preserved exactly

notes: Explode At Index is named in a Tree Sloth description from search results; the forum thread is a related question about exploding by first branch. Source URL not confirmed as fetched in the 2026-11-24 transcript audit; treat as unverified and re-check against official docs.

statement: Write data to a file and read it back (pack and unpack), with an option to watch the file for changes, so data can move between definitions and sessions.
superiority: Dino 8 should store trees in a versioned, typed format with exact round trip and automatic refresh when the file changes.

acceptance.corpus: Tree of numbers, text, points and curves, 10 000 items
acceptance.tolerance: Unpacked tree equals packed tree exactly (paths and values; geometry within 1e-12)

notes: Pack and Unpack Data are named in search-result summaries of Tree Sloth; the cited thread does not describe them. Treat details as unverified.
